name: hivepantry
description: HivePantry is a calorie and macronutrient log for AI agents. A Cloudflare Worker serves MCP and REST. D1 stores the log.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply hivepantry-db --local --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Your admin password, at least 16 characters. You sign in to /console with it and mint agent tokens there. Keep it somewhere safe.

PANTRY_TZ.description: Your IANA time zone, for example America/New_York. Days and daily totals follow it. Leave UTC if unsure.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional, for Google sign-in through Cloudflare Access. Leave empty now; docs/deploy.md says how to set it after the deploy.

ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional, for Google sign-in through Cloudflare Access. Leave empty now; docs/deploy.md says how to set it after the deploy.
